title: AI Receptionist Free Trial: Every Vendor's Terms (2026)
HVAC Answering Service: AI, Live, and July Call Math
After Hours Answering Service: Night and Weekend Prices

editor_changes.before: Every service ends a night call in one of three ways.
editor_changes.after: A night call ends in one of three ways.
editor_changes.why: Overgeneralization; not every vendor page describes its emergency path.

editor_changes.before: Dialzara's $29 plan does blind transfers but leaves out its "after-hours rules & escalation" feature.
editor_changes.after: Dialzara's $29 plan takes messages and does blind transfers, but leaves out its "after-hours rules & escalation" feature.
editor_changes.why: Listed under 'take a message'; snapshot shows Lite includes message taking with custom questions plus blind transfer.

editor_changes.before: PATLive has the lowest entry price with dispatch spelled out.
editor_changes.after: AnswerHero has the lowest live entry prices and lists call dispatching on all plans. PATLive spells out emergency dispatch on every plan.
editor_changes.why: AnswerHero ($39/$79) is cheaper than PATLive and its page says all plans include call dispatching.

editor_changes.before: $1.89 to $2.99 a minute in overage at AnswerHero and PATLive
editor_changes.after: like $1.89 a minute past AnswerHero's Starter plan or $2.99 on PATLive's pay-as-you-go plan
editor_changes.why: Range was cherry-picked; overage at both vendors runs lower on bigger plans ($1.12 AnswerHero, $1.79 PATLive).

editor_changes.before: hard calls go to a Smith.ai live receptionist
editor_changes.after: hard calls can go to a Smith.ai live receptionist
editor_changes.why: Snapshot says the call 'can be transferred'; not guaranteed.

editor_changes.before: Under about 17 minutes, a pay-as-you-go plan may be enough.
editor_changes.after: Below about 17 to 30 minutes, depending on the vendor, a pay-as-you-go plan is cheaper.
editor_changes.why: Break-even points computed above are about 17 (PATLive), 28 (Posh) and 30 (AnswerHero) minutes.
